rationale: Independently verified against ADR-038 s.6 hard exclusions: LRPC-3 touches only scripts/gemma-code-review.py::build_review_payload() and scripts/gemma_code_review_test.py::BuildReviewPayload. No auth/security work, no rights/consent/governance invariant, no schema/migration/release cut, no unresolved ADR decision, and scope is fully bounded (two named functions, explicit in/out-of-scope lists, explicit failure-mode and test-ownership contracts, all confirmed PASS at phase-1 by both gemma (canonical primary) and muse-glimmer). Concurs with Muse Glimmer's GO_LOCAL recommendation; no downgrade applied.
